physical_freestream_from_authoritative_c.calculation: Sutherland mu at source computational temperature; U=M*sqrt(gamma*R*T); rho=Re*mu/(U*c); p=rho*R*T. Pressure is derived, not fitted.

stored_solution_scaling.note: Native restart and VTU primitive fields are nondimensional under REF_DIMENSIONALIZATION=FREESTREAM_VEL_EQ_ONE; Cp/Cf are already dimensionless.

farfield_physical_momentum_flux_quadratu.method: Trapezoid nodal physical momentum/pressure perturbation flux at outer boundary, subtracting uniform freestream analytically; far viscous traction neglected. This is not the solver discrete flux including JST dissipation and is not an automatic acceptance test.

wall_force_dimensional_per_unit_span.scope: 2D section per unit span; not total wing/aircraft loads
